markers.name: Calik
says: Calik> "What do you want, kid? So you came for advice from a veteran, huh? Well, go buy me a drink and I might have time to sit with ya..."
Calik> "I worked all day for months to keep you damned kids safe from the Dark Horde, and what thanks did I get?? Not so much as a large heal! Ungrateful spoiled brats."

Calik> "You know what really gets to me? Ever since the frogs moved here to the valley, there has been this one that always wants to jump in and dirty the water of our fountain! We humans never go try to jump into their bathtubs. Bah, you wouldn"t understand..."

markers.name: Terard
says: Terard> "Hey... do you have a sister about my age?"
Terard> "Sit with me and have a drink!"
Terard> "Ahhh, nothing better than sitting down for some drinks with good company!"

markers.name: Tika - Soothsayer
says: Just wait, I will give you insight into the spirit world yet. My time to speak is not now.
